```{r data_import}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, 
  warning = FALSE, 
  message = FALSE, 
  error = FALSE,
  fig.pos = 'H',
  out.width = "100%")

source("Libraries.R")
merged_data <- read.csv("Input/merged_data.csv")

# metto a posto la tipologia di variabile
cols_date <- c("Data_di_nascita", "Data_esordio", "Data_diagnosi", "Data_prelievo_T0", "data_referto_T6", "data_referto_T12", "data_referto_T18", "data_referto_T24", "data_referto_T30", "data_referto_T36", "data_cambio_terapia", "sample_collection_date", "glc_date_before_t0")
merged_data[cols_date] <- lapply(merged_data[cols_date], as.Date)
cols_factor <- c("lesioni_T6", "relapse_T6", "lesioni_T12", "relapse_T12",
                "lesioni_T18", "relapse_T18", "lesioni_T24", "relapse_T24",
                "lesioni_T30", "relapse_T30", "lesioni_T36", "relapse_T36",
                "cambio_terapia", "lesion_burden", "bone_marrow_lesions",
                "subtentorial_lesions", "gadolinium_contrast", "full_recovery", "naive", "smoking_habit", "antibiotic_use", "spike_in")
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(cols_factor), ~ case_when(
      .x %in% c("No", "no", "0", 0) ~ "No",
      .x %in% c("Yes", "yes", "1", 1) ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("No", "Yes"))))

cols_factor2 <- c("glucocorticoid_treatment", "gc_treatment", "prognosis_at_onset")
merged_data[cols_factor2] <- lapply(merged_data[cols_factor2], factor, levels = c("Positive", "Negative")) # DT qui i livelli erano maiuscoli e, dato che non matchavano, dava valori NA a tutto
merged_data$physical_activity <- factor(merged_data$physical_activity, levels = c("active", "sedentary", "partially_active"))
merged_data$simplified_batch <- factor(merged_data$simplified_batch, levels = c("1-3", "4-5"))
merged_data$disease_activity <- factor(merged_data$disease_activity, levels = c("higher_activity", "lower_activity"))
merged_data$sex <- factor(merged_data$sex, levels = c("M", "F"))
merged_data$sequencing_batch <- factor(merged_data$sequencing_batch, levels = c("1", "2", "3"))
merged_data$CENTRO <- factor(merged_data$CENTRO, levels = c("CLERICO", "NAPOLI", "MOLINETTE", "CRESM"))
merged_data$clinical_presentation <- factor(merged_data$clinical_presentation)



cols_numeric <- c("MEDAS", "cortisone_T6", "cortisone_T12", "cortisone_T18", "cortisone_T24", "cortisone_T30", "cortisone_T36", "age_at_t0", "bmi", "dna_quantification", "days_gc_collection", "percent_th17", "treg_il10_pos", "treg_cd39_pos", "age")
merged_data[cols_numeric] <- lapply(merged_data[cols_numeric], as.numeric)

#Pulizia x evitare crash LaTeX
merged_data$NOTE <- gsub("[#$%&_]", " ", merged_data$NOTE)
merged_data$nuova_terapia <- gsub("[#$%&_]", " ", merged_data$nuova_terapia)
merged_data$previous_therapy <- gsub("[#$%&_]", " ", merged_data$previous_therapy)
```

EDSS trend for each MAV patient, lineplot:
```{r lineplot}

#####lineplot
edss_long <- merged_data %>%
  select(ID, cambio_terapia, starts_with("EDSS_T")) %>%
  mutate(cambio_terapia = tidyr::replace_na(cambio_terapia, "No")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("EDSS_T"),
    names_to = "timepoint",
    values_to = "EDSS"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(EDSS))%>%
  mutate(
    timepoint = factor(
      timepoint,
      levels = paste0("EDSS_T", c(0, 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36)),
      labels = paste0("T", c(0, 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36))
    )
  )

# Ultimo timepoint di ciascun paziente
last_points <- edss_long %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  filter(as.numeric(timepoint) == max(as.numeric(timepoint))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Creo grafico
ggplot(edss_long, aes(x = timepoint, y = EDSS, group = ID)) +

  # Linee dei singoli pazienti
  geom_line(aes(color = ID), alpha = 0.6, size = 0.6) +

  # Punti con jitter orizzontale e verticale
  geom_point(
    aes(color = ID),
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 1.2,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.1,
      height = 0.08,
      seed = 42
    )
  ) +

  # Evidenzia l'ultimo punto con forma diversa se cambio terapia
  geom_point(
    data = last_points,
    aes(color = ID, shape = cambio_terapia),
    size = 3
  ) +

  # Etichette ID
  geom_text_repel(
    data = last_points,
    aes(label = ID, color = ID),
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold",
    nudge_x = 0.2,
    segment.alpha = 0,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # Media della coorte
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = 1),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    size = 1.3,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    aes(group = 1),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 2.5,
    color = "black",
    shape = 18
  ) +

  # Colori
  scale_color_manual(
    values = as.vector(pals::polychrome(length(unique(edss_long$ID)))),
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  # Forma ultimo punto
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "No" = 16,   # cerchio
      "Yes" = 17   # stella
    ),
    name = "Therapy switch"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "EDSS Progression Over Time",
    subtitle = "Black: cohort average | Coloured: each MAV patient",
    x = "Timepoints",
    y = "EDSS value"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey30"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 40, 10, 10)
  )
```
EDSS trend for each MAV patient, Sankey plot:
```{r sankey}
####sankey interattivo mettendo EDSS in categorie (altrimenti vengono troppi incroci)
# Classi EDSS
sankey_data <- merged_data %>%
  transmute(
    ID,
    T0 = case_when(
      EDSS_T0 < 3 ~ "<3",
      EDSS_T0 < 6 ~ "3-5.5",
      TRUE ~ "≥6"
    ),
    T6 = case_when(
      EDSS_T6 < 3 ~ "<3",
      EDSS_T6 < 6 ~ "3-5.5",
      TRUE ~ "≥6"
    ),
    T12 = case_when(
      EDSS_T12 < 3 ~ "<3",
      EDSS_T12 < 6 ~ "3-5.5",
      TRUE ~ "≥6"
    ),
    T18 = case_when(
      EDSS_T18 < 3 ~ "<3",
      EDSS_T18 < 6 ~ "3-5.5",
      TRUE ~ "≥6"
    ),
    T24 = case_when(
      EDSS_T24 < 3 ~ "<3",
      EDSS_T24 < 6 ~ "3-5.5",
      TRUE ~ "≥6"
    ),
    T30 = case_when(
      EDSS_T30 < 3 ~ "<3",
      EDSS_T30 < 6 ~ "3-5.5",
      TRUE ~ "≥6"
    ),
    T36 = case_when(
      EDSS_T36 < 3 ~ "<3",
      EDSS_T36 < 6 ~ "3-5.5",
      TRUE ~ "≥6"
    )
  )

links <- bind_rows(
  sankey_data %>% count(T0, T6) %>% rename(source=T0,target=T6,value=n),
  sankey_data %>% count(T6, T12) %>% rename(source=T6,target=T12,value=n),
  sankey_data %>% count(T12, T18) %>% rename(source=T12,target=T18,value=n),
  sankey_data %>% count(T18, T24) %>% rename(source=T18,target=T24,value=n),
  sankey_data %>% count(T24, T30) %>% rename(source=T24,target=T30,value=n),
  sankey_data %>% count(T30, T36) %>% rename(source=T30,target=T36,value=n)
)

links <- bind_rows(
  sankey_data %>% transmute(source=paste0("T0_",T0), target=paste0("T6_",T6)),
  sankey_data %>% transmute(source=paste0("T6_",T6), target=paste0("T12_",T12)),
  sankey_data %>% transmute(source=paste0("T12_",T12), target=paste0("T18_",T18)),
  sankey_data %>% transmute(source=paste0("T18_",T18), target=paste0("T24_",T24)),
  sankey_data %>% transmute(source=paste0("T24_",T24), target=paste0("T30_",T30)),
  sankey_data %>% transmute(source=paste0("T30_",T30), target=paste0("T36_",T36))
) %>%
  count(source, target, name="value")

nodes <- data.frame(
  name = unique(c(links$source, links$target))
)

links$source <- match(links$source, nodes$name) - 1
links$target <- match(links$target, nodes$name) - 1

sankeyNetwork(
  Links = links,
  Nodes = nodes,
  Source = "source",
  Target = "target",
  Value = "value",
  NodeID = "name",
  fontSize = 12,
  nodeWidth = 25
)

```

Disability trend: EDSS variation histogram
``` {r EDSS histogram}
# EDSS finale 
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    EDSS_finale = last(na.omit(c(
      as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T0)),
      as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T6)),
      as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T12)),
      as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T18)),
      as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T24)),
      as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T30)),
      as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T36))
    )))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Delta EDSS
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    EDSS_T0_num = as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T0)),
    delta_EDSS = EDSS_finale - EDSS_T0_num
  )

# Andamento EDSS
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    andamento_EDSS = case_when(

      EDSS_T0_num == 0 &
        delta_EDSS >= 1.5 ~ "EDSS worsening",

      EDSS_T0_num >= 1 &
        EDSS_T0_num <= 5.5 &
        delta_EDSS >= 1 ~ "EDSS worsening",

      EDSS_T0_num >= 6 &
        delta_EDSS >= 0.5 ~ "EDSS worsening",

      abs(delta_EDSS) < 0.5 &
        EDSS_T0_num < 3 ~ "Low stable",

      abs(delta_EDSS) < 0.5 &
        EDSS_T0_num >= 3 ~ "High stable",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Classe EDSS basale
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    EDSS_class = if_else(
      EDSS_T0_num >= 3,
      "EDSS ≥ 3",
      "EDSS < 3"
    )
  )

plot_df <- merged_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(andamento_EDSS)) %>%
  count(andamento_EDSS, EDSS_class)

ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = andamento_EDSS,
    y = n,
    fill = EDSS_class
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = "stack",
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "EDSS < 3" = "darkblue",
      "EDSS ≥ 3" = "lightblue"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Number of MAV patients",
    fill = "Baseline EDSS"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

########chord plot suggerito al posto dell'istogramma
#flussi
chord_df <- plot_df %>%
  rename(
    from = EDSS_class,
    to   = andamento_EDSS,
    value = n
  )

# Colori dei nodi
grid.col <- c(
  "EDSS < 3" = "darkblue",
  "EDSS ≥ 3" = "lightblue",
  "Low stable" = "#1b9e77",
  "High stable" = "#7570b3",
  "EDSS worsening" = "#d95f02"
)

# Pulisce eventuali grafici precedenti
circos.clear()

# Chord plot
chordDiagram(
  x = chord_df,
  grid.col = grid.col,
  transparency = 0.25,
  directional = 1,
  direction.type = c("arrows", "diffHeight"),
  annotationTrack = "grid",
  preAllocateTracks = 1
)

# Etichette dei settori
circos.trackPlotRegion(
  track.index = 1,
  panel.fun = function(x, y) {
    sector.name = get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
    circos.text(
      x = get.cell.meta.data("xcenter"),
      y = get.cell.meta.data("ylim")[1] + 0.1,
      labels = sector.name,
      facing = "clockwise",
      niceFacing = TRUE,
      adj = c(0, 0.5),
      cex = 0.8
    )
  },
  bg.border = NA
)
```

NEDA-3 (No Evidence of Disease Activity):
- No clinical relapses.
- No new or enlarging lesions.
- No confirmed disability progression (CDP) sustained for at least 6 months, defined as:
EDSS = 0 at baseline: increase of ≥1.5 points.
EDSS 1.0–5.5 at baseline: increase of ≥1.0 point.
EDSS ≥6.0 at baseline: increase of ≥0.5 points.

*Gadolinium-enhanced lesions excluded: only T0 data available.

```{r survival_NEDA3}

#neda3 solo al t0
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    EDSS_last = {
      x <- c(EDSS_T36, EDSS_T30, EDSS_T24,
             EDSS_T18, EDSS_T12, EDSS_T6, EDSS_T0)
      x[which(!is.na(x))[1]]
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#=========================
# Peggioramento EDSS
#=========================

merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    EDSS_worsening = case_when(
      EDSS_T0 == 0 ~ (EDSS_last - EDSS_T0) >= 1.5,
      EDSS_T0 >= 1 & EDSS_T0 <= 5 ~ (EDSS_last - EDSS_T0) >= 1,
      EDSS_T0 > 5 ~ (EDSS_last - EDSS_T0) >= 0.5,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

#=========================
# Eventi NEDA
#=========================

merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    event_6_C  = EDSS_worsening | relapse_T6  == "Yes" | lesioni_T6  == "Yes",
    event_12_C = EDSS_worsening | relapse_T12 == "Yes" | lesioni_T12 == "Yes",
    event_18_C = EDSS_worsening | relapse_T18 == "Yes" | lesioni_T18 == "Yes",
    event_24_C = EDSS_worsening | relapse_T24 == "Yes" | lesioni_T24 == "Yes",
    event_30_C = EDSS_worsening | relapse_T30 == "Yes" | lesioni_T30 == "Yes",
    event_36_C = EDSS_worsening | relapse_T36 == "Yes" | lesioni_T36 == "Yes"
  )

#=========================
# Tempo al primo evento
#=========================

merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    event_time_C = case_when(
      event_6_C  ~ 6,
      event_12_C ~ 12,
      event_18_C ~ 18,
      event_24_C ~ 24,
      event_30_C ~ 30,
      event_36_C ~ 36,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    event_status_C = ifelse(is.na(event_time_C), 0, 1),
    time_C = ifelse(is.na(event_time_C), 36, event_time_C)
  )

surv_obj4 <- Surv(
  time = merged_data$time_C,
  event = merged_data$event_status_C
)

fit4 <- survfit(surv_obj4 ~ 1, data = merged_data)

ggsurvplot(
  fit4,
  data = merged_data,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  pval = TRUE,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  xlab = "Months",
  ylab = "Probability of remaining NEDA-3",
  break.time.by = 6,
  surv.median.line = "none"
)

```
NEDA-3 divided by type of disease activity:
1. EDSS
``` {r survival_NEDA3_EDSS}
####EDSS - confrontando con neda3 ma sempre sul T0!!!!

merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    EDSS_last = {
      x <- c(EDSS_T36, EDSS_T30, EDSS_T24,
             EDSS_T18, EDSS_T12, EDSS_T6, EDSS_T0)
      x[which(!is.na(x))[1]]
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#=========================
# Peggioramento EDSS
#=========================

merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    EDSS_worsening = case_when(
      EDSS_T0 == 0 ~ (EDSS_last - EDSS_T0) >= 1.5,
      EDSS_T0 >= 1 & EDSS_T0 <= 5 ~ (EDSS_last - EDSS_T0) >= 1,
      EDSS_T0 > 5 ~ (EDSS_last - EDSS_T0) >= 0.5,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

#=========================
# Survival (solo EDSS)
#=========================

merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    event_status_EDSS = ifelse(EDSS_worsening, 1, 0),
    time_EDSS = ifelse(EDSS_worsening, 6, 36)
  )

#=========================
# Kaplan-Meier
#=========================

surv_obj <- Surv(
  time = merged_data$time_EDSS,
  event = merged_data$event_status_EDSS
)

fit <- survfit(surv_obj ~ 1, data = merged_data)

ggsurvplot(
  fit,
  data = merged_data,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  pval = TRUE,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  legend.title = "Groups",
  break.time.by = 6,
  #legend.labs = c("TEC GC+", "TEC GC-", "MAV GC+", "MAV GC-"),
  xlab = "Months",
  ylab = "EDSS worsening-free survival"
)
```

NEDA-3 divided by type of disease activity, stratified by Glucocorticoid treatment at baseline (without naive!!!):
1. EDSS
``` {r survival_GC_EDSS}
#####con il neda di ceci
#=========================
# Gruppi GC
#=========================

merged_data_naive <- merged_data_naive %>%
  mutate(
    gc = ifelse(gc_treatment == "Positive", 1, 0),
    gc_group = case_when(
      gc == 1 ~ "MAV_GC+",
      gc == 0 ~ "MAV_GC-"
    )
  )

merged_data_naive$gc_group <- factor(
  merged_data_naive$gc_group,
  levels = c("MAV_GC+", "MAV_GC-")
)

#=========================
# Ultimo EDSS disponibile
#=========================

merged_data_naive <- merged_data_naive %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    EDSS_last = {
      x <- c(EDSS_T36, EDSS_T30, EDSS_T24,
             EDSS_T18, EDSS_T12, EDSS_T6, EDSS_T0)
      x[which(!is.na(x))[1]]
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#=========================
# Peggioramento EDSS
#=========================

merged_data_naive <- merged_data_naive %>%
  mutate(
    EDSS_worsening = case_when(
      EDSS_T0 == 0 ~ (EDSS_last - EDSS_T0) >= 1.5,
      EDSS_T0 >= 1 & EDSS_T0 <= 5 ~ (EDSS_last - EDSS_T0) >= 1,
      EDSS_T0 > 5 ~ (EDSS_last - EDSS_T0) >= 0.5,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

#=========================
# Survival (solo EDSS)
#=========================

merged_data_naive <- merged_data_naive %>%
  mutate(
    event_status_EDSS = ifelse(EDSS_worsening, 1, 0),
    time_EDSS = ifelse(EDSS_worsening, 6, 36)
  )

#=========================
# Kaplan-Meier
#=========================

surv_obj <- Surv(
  time = merged_data_naive$time_EDSS,
  event = merged_data_naive$event_status_EDSS
)

fit <- survfit(
  surv_obj ~ gc_group,
  data = merged_data_naive
)

ggsurvplot(
  fit,
  data = merged_data_naive,
  risk.table = FALSE,
  pval = TRUE,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  legend.title = "Groups",
  #legend.labs = c("TEC GC+", "TEC GC-", "MAV GC+", "MAV GC-"),
  xlab = "Months",
  ylab = "EDSS worsening-free survival"
)
```

Glucocorticoid treatment during time, representation of the number of treatments and duration:
``` {r GC_duration}
####istogramma
#CATEGORIE DI DURATA CORTISONE
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    gc_category = case_when(
      rowSums(across(starts_with("cortisone_T"), ~ . > 0), na.rm = TRUE) == 0 ~ "None",
      rowSums(across(starts_with("cortisone_T"), ~ . > 0), na.rm = TRUE) <= 1 ~ "1",
      TRUE ~ "More 1"
    ),
    gc_category = factor(
      gc_category,
      levels = c("None", "1", "More 1")
    )
  )

ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = gc_category)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    x = "GC category",
    y = "Number of patients"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

######stacked durata
#plot durata cortisone 
gc_long <- merged_data %>%
  select(
    ID,
    cortisone_T6,
    cortisone_T12,
    cortisone_T18,
    cortisone_T24,
    cortisone_T30,
    cortisone_T36
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("cortisone_T"),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "Days"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = gsub("cortisone_", "", Timepoint),
    Days = replace_na(Days, 0)
  )


ggplot(gc_long,
       aes(x = factor(ID),
           y = Days,
           fill = Timepoint)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(Days > 0, Days, "")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Patient ID",
    y = "Days of corticosteroid treatment",
    fill = "Timepoint"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)
  )
```

Survival plot NEDA-3, stratified by clinical variable, Spinal lesions:
``` {r survival_spinal}
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    spinal = ifelse( bone_marrow_lesions == "Yes", 1, 0),
    spinal_group = case_when(
      spinal == 1 ~ "MAV spinal+",
      spinal == 0 ~ "MAV spinal-"
    )
  )

merged_data$therapy_group <- factor(
  merged_data$therapy_group,
  levels = c("MAV_change+", "MAV_change-")
)

merged_data_naive <- merged_data %>%
  filter(naive != "No")

#=========================
# Ultimo EDSS disponibile
#=========================

merged_data_naive <- merged_data_naive %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    EDSS_last = {
      x <- c(EDSS_T36, EDSS_T30, EDSS_T24,
             EDSS_T18, EDSS_T12, EDSS_T6, EDSS_T0)
      x[which(!is.na(x))[1]]
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#=========================
# Peggioramento EDSS
#=========================

merged_data_naive <- merged_data_naive %>%
  mutate(
    EDSS_worsening = case_when(
      EDSS_T0 == 0 ~ (EDSS_last - EDSS_T0) >= 1.5,
      EDSS_T0 >= 1 & EDSS_T0 <= 5 ~ (EDSS_last - EDSS_T0) >= 1,
      EDSS_T0 > 5 ~ (EDSS_last - EDSS_T0) >= 0.5,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

#=========================
# Eventi NEDA
#=========================

merged_data_naive <- merged_data_naive %>%
  mutate(
    event_6_C  = EDSS_worsening | relapse_T6  == "Yes" | lesioni_T6  == "Yes",
    event_12_C = EDSS_worsening | relapse_T12 == "Yes" | lesioni_T12 == "Yes",
    event_18_C = EDSS_worsening | relapse_T18 == "Yes" | lesioni_T18 == "Yes",
    event_24_C = EDSS_worsening | relapse_T24 == "Yes" | lesioni_T24 == "Yes",
    event_30_C = EDSS_worsening | relapse_T30 == "Yes" | lesioni_T30 == "Yes",
    event_36_C = EDSS_worsening | relapse_T36 == "Yes" | lesioni_T36 == "Yes"
  )

#=========================
# Tempo al primo evento
#=========================

merged_data_naive <- merged_data_naive %>%
  mutate(
    event_time_C = case_when(
      event_6_C  ~ 6,
      event_12_C ~ 12,
      event_18_C ~ 18,
      event_24_C ~ 24,
      event_30_C ~ 30,
      event_36_C ~ 36,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    event_status_C = ifelse(is.na(event_time_C), 0, 1),
    time_C = ifelse(is.na(event_time_C), 36, event_time_C)
  )

#=========================
# Kaplan-Meier
#=========================

surv_obj <- Surv(time = merged_data_naive$time_C,
                 event = merged_data_naive$event_status_C)

fit <- survfit(surv_obj ~ spinal_group, data = merged_data_naive)

ggsurvplot(
  fit,
  data = merged_data_naive,
  risk.table = FALSE,
  pval = TRUE,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  legend.title = "Groups",
    xlab = "Months",
  ylab = "NEDA-free survival"
)

```
